entities.summary: The Philippine Navy (PN) is the naval warfare service branch of the Armed Forces of the Philippines. It has an estimated strength of 24,500 active service personnel, including the 10,300-strong Philippine Marine Corps. It operates 95 combat vessels, 21 support vessels, 27 manned aircraft and 8 unmanned aerial vehicles.
